# Closerice 食評筆記 — AI agent instructions

Site: https://bunbun.space/closerice/
Human guide: https://bunbun.space/closerice/ai/
API specification: https://bunbun.space/closerice/openapi.json

Closerice requires Google sign-in. Every review belongs to one shared collection, and each user can belong to several collections. The API accepts a signed-in browser session and requires the X-Collection-Id header on review requests. A person must be an owner or editor in that collection to add or change records. A public URL alone does not grant access.

When an AI assistant can use the save_closerice_review tool registered by the signed-in Closerice page, it may save a review only at the user's request. Confirm the selected collection before saving. Read only visible receipt details and ask the user for missing dates, restaurant names, food, and district; never invent a rating or comment. Do not upload or store order screenshots. If the assistant cannot use the signed-in page tool, provide a draft for the user to enter in Closerice. Do not ask the user to paste a login cookie into chat.

Food photos are saved only when a person intentionally chooses them in the website form. Custom tags and favourite/blacklist status are separate, and each collection has its own tags.
